quote: The “data center city” represents an initial investment of USD 500 million (around BRL 3 billion) in the first phase alone, marking a decisive step toward positioning Brazil as a central hub in the global Artificial Intelligence (AI) revolution and transforming Rio Grande do Sul through the economic potential of digital infrastructure.
note: Opened Scala English LOI press; USD 500m Phase 1 / 54 MW / Eldorado do Sul / DigitalBridge support confirmed.
